verdict.rationale: Workable documents its own Workable Agent, which autonomously 'runs the top of the funnel - sourcing, screening and qualifying every candidate' and delivers a shortlist. That is a first-party background automation, but the evidence shows nothing about users configuring their own automations, triggers, or recurring schedules. Webhooks, the API and the MCP server are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation rules or workflows, trigger or schedule setup, documentation of how the agent runs unattended, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: The Workable Agent runs the top of the funnel - sourcing, screening and qualifying every candidate against the spec - and hands your team an interview-ready shortlist.
